# Cloud LMS vs Self-Hosted for Coaching: 2026 Verdict

**Source:** https://allcoaching.in/blogs/en/cloud-lms-vs-self-hosted-for-coaching  
**Published:** 2026-05-19  
**Updated:** 2026-05-21  
**Author:** Amit Ratan, Founder &amp; CEO, AllCoaching  

**Summary:** Cloud LMS vs self-hosted for coaching: cloud wins on real Year-1 cost, security and zero DevOps for most Indian educators. Self-hosted Moodle only pays off at scale.

In this article


- "Cloud or self-hosted?" is the wrong first question.

- What "self-hosted LMS" actually means in 2026 India.

- What "cloud LMS" actually means and its four sub-types.

- Self-hosted Year-1 cost — line by line.

- Cloud LMS Year-1 cost — by sub-type.

- DevOps, security, and the night before the exam — the burden cloud absorbs.

- When self-hosted is actually right — the narrow but real cases.

- When cloud wins — which is most of the time.

- AllCoaching's structural position — marketplace cloud, not white-label.

- The verdict — by stage and constraint.

- "Cloud or self-hosted?" is — a stage question, not a technology question.







Key Takeaways — the entire decision in seven facts:

- "Cloud LMS vs self-hosted" is not a software question — it is a permanent operational commitment. Self-hosted means a salaried engineer for the rest of your business's life. Cloud means that responsibility is the vendor's. Most coaching teachers underestimate this by an order of magnitude.

- Self-hosted Year-1 real cost: ₹2.5–6 lakh. The open-source software is free; the production system is not. Server (₹40K–₹1.5L), bandwidth (₹30K–₹1L), email infrastructure (₹15K–₹40K), plugin licenses + theme + initial customisation (₹50K–₹2L), DevOps engineer (₹5–12 lakh/year — even part-time eats your margin).

- Cloud LMS Year-1 real cost: ₹0–₹11 lakh depending on tier. Marketplace cloud (AllCoaching): ₹0 upfront + 10% rev-share on paid earnings only. Creator LMS (Graphy): ₹40K–₹2L. White-label SaaS (Classplus, Teachmint): ₹4–11 lakh once hidden costs (custom domain, DRM, gateway commission, marketing) are added.

- Self-hosted gives control of a server. Cloud gives control of your teaching. Pick the control that determines whether your business wins or loses. For a coaching educator, that is almost always the teaching, not the server.

- Distribution is the question hosting does not answer. Self-hosted LMS, cloud SaaS, white-label — all three leave the "where do the first 500 paid students come from?" question unsolved. Only marketplace cloud bundles distribution into the hosting layer.

- Self-hosted is structurally rational only at 20,000+ student scale or under specific compliance constraints. Below that, the DevOps overhead destroys the margin advantage. India's most common self-hosting mistake is doing it at solo-educator scale because "open-source means free".

- Data portability matters more than monthly price. A cloud LMS with full export beats a cheaper cloud LMS with a lock-in clause every single time over a 3-year horizon. Read the export clause before signing the contract.

Section 01

## "Cloud or self-hosted?" is
the wrong first question.

Every month a coaching teacher emails AllCoaching with some variation of: "Should I install Moodle on my own server or use a SaaS LMS?" The question sounds technical. It is not. It is an operational and financial question wearing a technical costume. And the answer is almost never the one the asker expects, because the asker is usually framing it as "which one is cheaper / more flexible" when the real frame is "which one is honest about what I am committing to for the next three years".

Here is the unflattering truth, said early: most Indian coaching businesses that choose self-hosted in 2026 do so because they read one Reddit thread that called Moodle "free" and one YouTube video that called SaaS LMS "a rip-off". Both are technically true and both miss the point. Open-source software is free. Running open-source software in production for 800 paying students is not. The cost shows up in salaries, late-night server alerts, lost data after a botched upgrade, and the 47 minutes you spend on exam morning explaining to angry parents why the login page is down. That cost does not appear on a website; it appears in the lived experience of running the thing.

The Right First Question

### "Do I want to run software, or do I want to teach?"

That is the actual cloud-vs-self-hosted decision. If your answer is "teach", a cloud LMS is structurally correct — the only remaining decision is which cloud LMS (marketplace, white-label SaaS, creator LMS, Big EdTech). If your answer is genuinely "run software" — because you have engineering capacity, compliance requirements, or audit-driven needs — then self-hosted opens up. Outside those specific cases, the choice is closed before the technical comparison even begins.

Across the AllCoaching educator base in 2026, we have watched the self-hosting decision unfold the same way enough times to call it a pattern: month 1 — excitement, "I own my server"; month 4 — first surprise patch cycle eats a weekend; month 9 — a plugin update breaks payment integration the night before a paid test series goes live; month 14 — the part-time DevOps person quits, the founder spends three weeks Googling stack-traces; month 18 — institute migrates to a cloud LMS at a cost of ₹3–8 lakh in lost time and re-platforming. The architecture decision was wrong on day one; the cost was paid over eighteen months.

The cheapest LMS is not the one with the lowest sticker price. The cheapest LMS is the one whose total cost — software, server, salary, sleep, opportunity — over three years is lowest. That calculation almost never favours self-hosting at coaching scale.

· · ·

Section 02

## What "self-hosted LMS" actually means
in 2026 India.

Before the comparison, definitional clarity. Self-hosted LMS means the coaching business itself runs the production environment — software, server, database, CDN, backups, security. The software is usually open-source (Moodle, Open edX, Chamilo, Canvas LMS) or, less commonly, custom-built on Django, Laravel, or Node. The hosting target is typically AWS, DigitalOcean, Hetzner, Linode, or — for the cost-sensitive — a single bare-metal server in an Indian colocation facility. The institute holds the database, the SSL certificates, the email reputation, and the operational responsibility.

The three serious choices in 2026 India look like this:

- Moodle — PHP-based, the most widely deployed open-source LMS globally. Mature, plugin-rich, but architecturally aged. Best fit for universities and large institutions where the IT department already runs PHP/MySQL stacks. Plugin ecosystem is its strength and its weakness — many critical plugins are paid, and plugin compatibility breaks across major version upgrades.

- Open edX — Python/Django, the platform that runs edX itself. Heavyweight, container-native (Tutor for deployment), modern frontend. Best fit for organisations producing MOOC-style content at scale. Setup is significantly harder than Moodle; you will spend the first month learning Docker, Kubernetes, and a custom CLI tool before you serve a single student.

- Custom-built — Django/Laravel/Node app stitched together by the institute's engineering team or a development agency. Total control, total responsibility. Year-1 build cost ₹8–25 lakh depending on scope. The road most coaching businesses think they want and then quietly regret.

Notice what is implicit in all three options: someone has to run them. Not "set them up once and forget". Run them — patch them, monitor them, scale them, secure them, back them up, restore them when something goes wrong. In a coaching business this is not a part-time task you give to your most technical teacher; it is a salaried role. Treating it as anything else is how data losses, exam-day outages, and slow death by compliance violations happen.

Honest Definition

### What you sign up for when you self-host

A 36-month operational commitment to running production software. This commitment exists whether or not you write it down — the day you tell a student "you can log in here and access your course", you have implicitly promised them that this login page will work tomorrow morning, will not lose their data, and will not leak their phone number to attackers. Self-hosting means that promise is yours to keep. Cloud LMS means that promise is the vendor's to keep, contractually.

· · ·

Section 03

## What "cloud LMS" actually means
and its four sub-types.

Cloud LMS means the vendor runs the production environment. The educator accesses the system through a web browser or a branded mobile app. The vendor handles servers, security patches, uptime, backups, scaling. The educator handles teaching. This is the foundational trade — pay the vendor a subscription or a revenue-share; receive operational continuity in return.

But "cloud LMS" is a broad category. Four sub-types matter in India 2026, and the difference between them is large enough to change the conclusion of any comparison:

- White-label SaaS (Classplus, Teachmint) — Pre-built coaching app rented under the educator's brand. App is fully branded; distribution is self-handled. Advertised price ₹X,XXX/month; real Year-1 cost lands at ₹4–11 lakh once domain, payment gateway commission, DRM, marketing budget and 12-month lock-in are added.

- Creator LMS (Graphy, Teachable, Thinkific) — Course-creator focused, strong for digital course economics with recorded content. Modern UX, clean monetization, email automation. Narrow fit for exam-prep Indian coaching (NEET, JEE, UPSC, SSC) where live batch + doubt sessions matter more than drip courses.

- Big EdTech Educator Platforms (Unacademy Educator, Vedantu Educator) — Cloud LMS bundled with massive built-in audience. Reach is real. Cost: students are the platform's, not yours; revenue split typically 50–60% to educator; leaving the platform means leaving the audience.

- Marketplace Cloud (AllCoaching) — Each educator runs a branded studio on a shared platform with AI-driven student discovery built in. ₹0 upfront, 10% rev-share on paid earnings only, 90% to educator, daily payouts, full data portability. Distribution is bundled into hosting. The structural alternative to white-label SaaS for solo and small-institute educators.

This matters for the cloud-vs-self-hosted question because "cloud LMS" is not one thing. When someone says "cloud LMS is expensive", they usually mean white-label SaaS at ₹4–11 lakh Year-1. They usually do not know that marketplace cloud exists at ₹0 upfront with built-in distribution. The honest comparison is not self-hosted vs cloud; it is self-hosted vs (specific cloud sub-type that fits your stage).

Decision Hint

### If you are solo or small-batch, the cloud comparison is marketplace cloud, not SaaS

Most "cloud LMS is expensive" complaints come from teachers who compared Moodle (free software, ignored salary) against white-label SaaS (₹4–11 lakh Year-1, scared by sticker). The correct comparison for a solo or small-batch educator is Moodle's real cost (₹2.5–6 lakh Year-1 with salary) against marketplace cloud (₹0 upfront + 10% rev-share on paid earnings only). When framed this way, the conclusion almost always inverts. The broader strategic version of this debate is unpacked in is it better to build own app or join marketplace.

· · ·

Section 04 · The Real Numbers

## Self-hosted Year-1 cost —
line by line.

Software is free. Production is not. This is the honest breakdown of self-hosting Moodle (or an equivalent open-source LMS) for an Indian coaching business serving ~500 paid students in Year 1 — a typical mid-size institute scale. Numbers are 2026 India market rates. They are not optimistic; they are not pessimistic; they are what they actually cost.

Self-Hosted Moodle · Honest Year-1 Cost (500 Paid Students)

- Server / hosting (production-grade VPS or AWS small-cluster): ₹40K–₹1.5L/year

- Bandwidth + CDN (video streaming + content delivery): ₹30K–₹1L/year

- SSL certificate + custom domain: ₹2K–₹15K/year

- Transactional email infrastructure (SendGrid / SES / Postmark): ₹15K–₹40K/year

- Paid Moodle plugins (certificate, advanced quiz, payment, attendance): ₹25K–₹80K one-time + ₹10K–₹30K/year support

- Theme + branding + initial customisation: ₹30K–₹1.5L one-time

- Video DRM / anti-piracy layer (if courses include premium video): ₹60K–₹2L/year

- Payment gateway integration + commission (1.5–3% on transactions): ₹15K–₹45K/year on ₹15L revenue

- DevOps engineer (part-time minimum, full-time ideal): ₹3L–₹12L/year

- Backup + disaster recovery (storage + tooling + monitoring): ₹15K–₹50K/year

- Marketing budget (paid ads, content, SEO — self-hosting does not solve distribution): ₹2L–₹6L/year

- Year-1 real total: ₹2.5–6 lakh excluding marketing; ₹4.5–12 lakh with marketing.

Where the asymmetry hides: the DevOps salary. Coaching businesses chronically under-budget this line item because they imagine a "one-time setup" rather than a "permanent operational role". Even a part-time DevOps consultant at ₹25K/month is ₹3 lakh/year — and a part-time consultant cannot fix a database corruption at 11pm the night before NEET. The institutes that get this wrong are the institutes that find out, around month 12, that the real cost was always the engineer they did not hire.

Where the saving is real: per-student marginal cost. Once the infrastructure is paid for, adding 200 more students costs almost nothing — bandwidth scales, server scales modestly, no per-student platform fee. This is why self-hosting starts winning on cost only at scale (5,000+ students), where the fixed engineering cost is amortised over a large student base. Below that threshold, cloud is cheaper. Above it, self-hosted starts to be competitive — but only if the engineering team is real and the institute's leadership genuinely wants to run software.

"Moodle is free" is a sentence that has cost more Indian coaching businesses more money than any other single piece of EdTech folk-wisdom. The software is free. The system around it is not. Budget the system, not just the software.

· · ·

Section 05 · The Real Numbers

## Cloud LMS Year-1 cost —
by sub-type.

The same 500-paid-students scenario, but evaluated against the four cloud sub-types. Each one prices the trade-off differently — and each one bundles a different combination of hosting, branding, and distribution into the line items.

### Marketplace cloud (AllCoaching) — Year-1 real cost

- Upfront / monthly subscription: ₹0

- Revenue share (10% on paid student earnings only): ₹1.5L on ₹15L revenue (90% retained by educator = ₹13.5L)

- Server, bandwidth, security, DRM, payment gateway, daily payouts, GST invoicing, anti-piracy: included

- Marketing — partially absorbed by built-in AI student discovery (paid ads optional, not required): ₹0–₹50K/year

- Year-1 real total: ₹1.5L all-in (or ₹0 if revenue is ₹0 — pay only on paid earnings)

### Creator LMS (Graphy / equivalents) — Year-1 real cost

- Subscription: ₹3K–₹15K/month × 12 = ₹36K–₹1.8L/year

- Transaction fee (1.5–3% on ₹15L): ₹22K–₹45K/year

- Custom domain + email: ₹3K–₹15K/year

- Marketing (distribution self-handled): ₹2L–₹4L/year

- Year-1 real total: ₹40K–₹2L on software; ₹2.4L–₹6L with marketing

### White-label SaaS (Classplus / Teachmint) — Year-1 real cost

- Subscription: ₹30K–₹15L/year

- Setup / migration fee: ₹25K–₹2L one-time

- Custom domain + SSL: ₹3K–₹12K/year

- Payment gateway commission: ₹22K–₹45K/year on ₹15L

- Video CDN + DRM add-on: ₹40K–₹1.5L/year

- Marketing: ₹2L–₹6L/year

- Year-1 real total: ₹4–11 lakh (and 12-month subscription lock-in)

### Big EdTech Educator (Unacademy / equivalents)

- Upfront: ₹0

- Revenue split (40–50% to platform): ₹6L–₹7.5L taken by platform on ₹15L revenue

- Audience: reach included — but the audience is the platform's, not yours

- Brand: develops under the platform's name, not your own

- Year-1 real total: ₹0 cash; ₹6–7.5L structural — paid in audience ownership and brand independence

When compared like this, the popular intuition "self-hosted is the cheap one" collapses. Marketplace cloud is the cheapest by a clear margin at this scale, and structurally bundles distribution into hosting. White-label SaaS is the most expensive in raw cash, but offers deep customisation. Big EdTech costs the most when the price is honestly measured (the price is the audience). Self-hosted is in the middle on cash but the highest on operational responsibility.

· · ·

Section 06

## DevOps, security, and the night before the exam —
the burden cloud absorbs.

The cost spreadsheet shows part of the picture. The operational reality shows the rest. Three things in particular are routinely underestimated by coaching teachers evaluating self-hosting, and all three are absorbed silently by a competent cloud LMS.

The patch cycle. Every 4–8 weeks the Linux kernel, the database server, the language runtime (PHP for Moodle, Python for Open edX), and the LMS application itself ship security patches. Apply them late and you carry known exploits in production. Apply them carelessly and you break compatibility with a critical plugin. Apply them right and you spend a weekend per cycle reading changelogs, running staging tests, and rolling out to production. Annualised, this is 80–120 engineering hours that simply do not exist if you self-host without a real engineer. For a cloud LMS, this work happens for the vendor's entire customer base in parallel — your share of the cost is a tiny fraction of one engineer's time.

The exam-day surge. Coaching businesses have lumpy traffic. The night before NEET, JEE Main Day 2, the CAT result-day surge, the UPSC prelims live class — traffic spikes 10–50x baseline for a 6–24 hour window. A self-hosted server sized for normal load will die. A self-hosted server sized for peak load is over-provisioned 95% of the year and wastes money. Cloud LMS vendors auto-scale across all their customers' surges and absorb the cost in aggregate. The coaching business that loses a server during an exam-day live class does not just lose that day's revenue — it loses parent trust in a way that re-acquisition costs ₹15K–₹40K per student to repair.

The breach. Indian EdTech in 2024–25 saw a stream of data-breach incidents — most of them not from cloud platforms but from self-hosted coaching apps with neglected security hygiene. Default admin passwords, unpatched WordPress plugins, leaked database backups in public S3 buckets. A breach at an Indian coaching institute now triggers DPDP Act notification obligations, regulatory fines, and parent-led withdrawals. The coaching business that "saves" ₹3 lakh/year by skipping a security engineer does not realise the savings — it carries an off-balance-sheet liability worth ₹50L–₹2Cr in a breach scenario.

Operational Reality

### Cloud is not "less control" — it is "different control"

The popular narrative says cloud means giving up control. That is partially true; you give up control of the server. What you gain is control of your time, your security posture, your scalability, and your ability to focus on teaching instead of running infrastructure. The trade is real, but it is not "more freedom vs less freedom" — it is "freedom over the wrong things vs freedom over the right things". For an educator, the right things are content, pricing, student relationship, and growth — not kernel patches.

· · ·

Section 07

## When self-hosted is actually right —
the narrow but real cases.

Self-hosting is not stupid. It is structurally correct in specific scenarios, and pretending otherwise would be dishonest. Three scenarios genuinely justify the operational commitment.

Scenario 1 — Enterprise scale with an engineering team already in place. If you are running a 20,000+ student multi-branch chain, you already employ a small engineering team for other reasons — your CRM, your payment reconciliation, your test-paper authoring pipeline. The marginal cost of adding LMS-ops to that team is much lower than the marginal cost of cloud LMS revenue-share or per-student SaaS pricing at that scale. Self-hosting starts winning on TCO around 5,000–10,000 students if the engineering bench exists; it wins decisively at 20,000+. Major Indian coaching enterprises (Allen, FIITJEE, Aakash internal platforms) operate this way for exactly this reason.

Scenario 2 — Compliance or contractual data-residency constraints. Some government coaching contracts (skill-mission programmes, state-tendered teacher-training, defence-related upskilling) require data residency on specific Indian government clouds (MeghRaj, NIC) or on-premise infrastructure under DPDP-aligned audit. Cloud LMS vendors may not satisfy these contractual clauses; self-hosted (or private cloud) is the only option. This scenario is narrow, but if it applies, the decision is made for you.

Scenario 3 — Custom pedagogy that no cloud LMS supports. A small set of institutes run pedagogical workflows that genuinely have no cloud equivalent — adaptive testing engines with proprietary item-response-theory models, AI-tutoring agents tightly integrated with curriculum, gamified learning loops with custom XP economies. If you have validated demand and the custom workflow is genuinely your competitive moat, building on a self-hosted base lets you control the codebase. But — and this is critical — most institutes that say "my pedagogy is too unique for a cloud LMS" are wrong. They have not actually tested whether cloud LMS extensibility (APIs, webhooks, custom apps) can absorb their workflow. Test before you build.

Self-Honesty Check

### Are you in one of these three scenarios — really?

If you are reading this section thinking "yes, scenario 3 is me", pause. Most coaching educators dramatically over-estimate the uniqueness of their pedagogy. The honest test — can you write down five specific workflow steps that no cloud LMS in the comparison can support, with concrete API limitations to back the claim? If you cannot, you are probably in scenario 0 (cloud is fine) and have romanticised your differentiation.

· · ·

Section 08

## When cloud wins —
which is most of the time.

The honest finding from years of watching Indian coaching businesses make this decision: cloud wins for approximately 95% of coaching teachers, including solo educators, small-batch teachers, mid-size institutes up to ~2,000 students, and even most multi-branch chains under 10,000 students. The reasons compound:

- Operational continuity is bundled. Patches, backups, monitoring, scaling — all absorbed by the vendor across thousands of educators. The marginal cost of operational excellence per educator is a tiny fraction of running it independently.

- Security posture is professionalised. Real cloud LMS vendors run dedicated security teams, hold SOC 2 / ISO 27001 attestations, patch CVEs within hours, and run penetration tests on a schedule a coaching institute cannot afford in-house.

- Time to launch is days, not months. A cloud LMS goes from signup to first student enrolled in 24–72 hours. A self-hosted production setup takes 4–12 weeks from procurement to first paying student, even with experienced help.

- You stay in the business you signed up for. You opened a coaching business to teach. Self-hosting silently converts you into a software-running business that also teaches. That conversion is what most educators regret — not the money, the identity drift.

- Marketplace cloud uniquely solves distribution. No self-hosted system answers the question "where do my first 500 paid students come from?". White-label cloud doesn't either. Marketplace cloud (AllCoaching) is the only architecture that bundles AI-driven student discovery into the hosting layer.

The cloud vs self-hosted question is, for the overwhelming majority of Indian coaching businesses, already answered before it is asked. The remaining work is choosing which cloud — and that choice depends on stage, distribution problem, and ownership preferences.

Section 10 · The Decision Matrix

## The verdict —
by stage and constraint.

Five stages, mapped to the structurally correct hosting choice. Read the row that matches your current student count; the column on the right is the answer.

Hosting Decision Matrix — Indian Coaching Educator (2026)

- Solo educator (1–50 students) → Marketplace cloud (AllCoaching). Self-hosting wastes ₹2.5L on infrastructure that does not solve distribution.

- Small batch (50–250 students) → Marketplace cloud or creator cloud LMS. Self-hosting is not justified — student base too small to absorb DevOps overhead.

- Mid-size institute (250–2,000 students) → Cloud (marketplace or white-label SaaS). Self-hosted only if existing in-house engineering team is present and audit/compliance control is required.

- Multi-branch chain (2,000–20,000 students) → Hybrid — cloud control plane plus self-hosted regional cache can be rational. Pure self-hosted defensible only if engineering bench is in place.

- Enterprise / nationwide (20,000+ students) → Self-hosted or private cloud becomes structurally justified. Compliance, custom flows, vendor independence and audit control outweigh operational overhead at this scale.

The one-line answer for everyone else: if you have to ask, the answer is cloud. If you are below 2,000 students and reading this article, the answer is almost certainly marketplace cloud — because it is the only architecture that bundles distribution into hosting at zero upfront cost. The exceptions are real but narrow; if you are in one of them, you already know it.

Self-hosted is not a worse choice; it is a heavier choice. Choose it deliberately, with the engineering bench and the operational discipline to back it. Choose cloud, and choose specifically — marketplace cloud if you do not yet have an audience, white-label SaaS if you have a large existing audience and brand, creator LMS if you are a digital course creator with mostly recorded content, Big EdTech only if you are in the top 1% of educators and accept the trade of student ownership.

This is the longest pre-decision question a coaching business will face in its first three years. Get it right once, save 18 months of regret. Get it wrong, and the cost shows up not on any spreadsheet but in your weekends, your weeknights, and your students' trust.

Strategic Conclusion

## "Cloud or self-hosted?" is —
a stage question, not a technology question.

Return to the question that opened this guide — "should I install Moodle or use a SaaS LMS?" After the cost ledgers, the DevOps reality check, the data-portability clause analysis, and the four-sub-type breakdown of cloud LMS, the honest answer is three-layered.

First layer — cloud is not one thing. White-label SaaS (₹4–11 lakh Year-1), creator LMS (₹40K–₹2L/year), Big EdTech educator platforms (revenue split + student absorption), and marketplace cloud (₹0 upfront + 10% rev-share with bundled distribution) are four structurally different products. "Cloud LMS is expensive" usually compares Moodle against white-label SaaS — the wrong comparison for a solo or small-batch educator. The right comparison is Moodle's real cost against marketplace cloud.

Second layer — self-hosted is operational, not architectural. The decision is not "do I want control of the server?" — it is "do I want to permanently employ a DevOps engineer?" Open-source software is free; running production for 800 paying students is not. The Year-1 cost lands at ₹2.5–6 lakh excluding marketing, mostly absorbed by the salaried engineer required to keep the system up at exam-time peak load. Below 20,000 students, this maths almost never works.

Third layer — distribution is the question hosting cannot answer. Self-hosted Moodle, cloud SaaS, white-label apps — all three leave "where do the first 500 paid students come from?" unsolved. Only marketplace cloud bundles distribution into the hosting layer. For solo educators and small-institute teachers in 2026 India, this is the difference between a working LMS and a sustainable coaching business.

Indian coaching educators thriving in 2026 share a consistent pattern. They:

- Compared real Year-1 totals, not sticker prices — Moodle "free" against ₹2.5–6L all-in, white-label SaaS ₹X,XXX/month against ₹4–11L all-in, marketplace cloud against ₹0 upfront + rev-share.

- Treated DevOps as a salary, not a setup cost — and either committed to it honestly or chose the cloud path that removed the requirement entirely.

- Read the data-portability clause before signing, knowing that lock-in costs more over three years than monthly subscription differences.

- Recognised distribution as the load-bearing problem — and picked the architecture that bundled it in, not the architecture that left it as a separate ₹2–6L/year marketing line item.

Your next coaching season does not have to begin on the wrong architecture. Pick up your phone, visit studio.allcoaching.in, and your branded studio is live in 60 seconds — no server to provision, no DevOps engineer to hire, no Year-1 cost ledger to reconcile. Your first paid batch can run within 48 hours. This is not hyperbole; it is observable reality across 500+ Indian coaching educators every month in the AllCoaching base.

"Self-hosted gives you control over a server. Cloud gives you control over your teaching. Most coaching teachers confuse these two and pay for the wrong one for three years before realising. The correction is reversible — just earlier is cheaper than later."

— Amit Ratan, Founder & CEO, AllCoaching

Section 01

## "Free" ka asli matlab —
aur 3 honest paths.

"Apna coaching app kaise banaye free?" — yeh sawal pichle teen saalo me Indian educators ne sabse zyada Google par puchha hai. Aur sawal galat nahi hai. Galat sirf yeh hai ki jab aap iska answer dhundhte hain, aapko teen tarah ke jawab milte hain, aur teeno me se ek bhi poori honesty se nahi diya gaya.

Pehla jawab — "Flutter seekh lo, app banao". Yeh technically possible hai, lekin "free" nahi hai. Aap apne 4-9 mahine aur ₹3-15 lakh khud daalenge. Doosra jawab — "Classplus / Teachmint type ke white-label SaaS ka free trial le lo". Yeh ek month free hota hai, phir Year-1 me ₹4-11 lakh ka bill aata hai jo aapne signup ke time nahi dekha tha. Teesra jawab — vague claim ki "koi no-code platform try karo" — kaunsa, kis tarah, kiske jaisa, yeh kabhi nahi bataya jaata.

Iss guide me hum teeno paths ko honestly compare karenge, aur asli sawal jo aapko puchhna chahiye woh propose karenge. Yeh sawal hai — "kis architecture me kaam karu jis se mera coaching business chale aur technology mera bottleneck na bane?" Kyunki jab aap iss sawal ke answer ko optimize karte hain, "free coaching app" automatically ek by-product ki tarah aata hai. Doosra tareeke se sochenge to, "free coaching app" sirf agar aapne sahi architecture chuni ho.

Strategic Definition

### "Free Coaching App" — Asli Definition

A coaching app jaha educator ka upfront cash outlay ₹0 ho — no signup fee, no monthly subscription, no developer hire, no infrastructure purchase. Platform tabhi kamata hai jab educator kamata hai (revenue-share model). AllCoaching iss definition ko fit karta hai; white-label SaaS aur DIY routes nahi fit karte, kyunki dono me significant upfront ya recurring cash outlay hota hai — chahe woh paisa ho ya 6 mahine ka time.

Across the AllCoaching educator base in 2026, we have observed a consistent pattern — educators jo DIY route ya white-label route lete hain woh Phase 2 me ruk jaate hain. App ban gayi, lekin students aaye nahi. Kyunki "app banana" sirf 30% problem hai. Baki 70% problem — students kahaan se aayenge — har route me alag tarah se solve hota hai. Aur sirf marketplace route iss problem ko architecture me hi solve karta hai. Yeh structural difference hi pehle 100 educators ka result alag banata hai.

Aapko app banani nahi hai. Aapko ek system banana hai — teaching + payments + discovery — jo automatically chalein. App us system ka ek surface hai, problem nahi.

· · ·

Section 02

## Path 1 · DIY —
the 6-month timesink.

DIY route ka pitch glamorous hota hai — "apni khud ki app banwao, koi commission nahi, brand 100% aapka". Reality kuch aur hai. Solo educator jo Flutter ya React Native developer hire karke app banwata hai uska 9 me se 8 baar yeh outcome hota hai: app 4-9 mahine baad bani, launch hui, lekin marketing layer kabhi solve nahi hua, aur first 100 paid students aane me 1-2 saal lag gaye. Tab tak educator ne ₹3-15 lakh kharch kar diya hota hai aur energy bhi.

DIY ka honest cost breakdown teen layers me hota hai:

- Developer hire — ₹50K se ₹2L/month × 4-6 months. Full-stack Flutter/React Native developer, aur ek backend developer (Node.js/Python). Solo freelancer cheaper hai par delivery slow aur bug-heavy. Agency ki team faster lekin 2-3x mahanga.

- Designer + UX — ₹40K se ₹1.5L total. Figma designs, mobile + web UI/UX. Bina iske app "homemade" lagti hai aur students trust nahi karte. Skipping this step = 50% conversion drop.

- Infrastructure — ₹15K se ₹50K/month recurring. AWS/GCP hosting, CDN for videos (BunnyCDN/Cloudflare), Razorpay account, SMS gateway, email service. Year-1 me total ₹1.8-6 lakh sirf infrastructure pe.

Yeh sab milkar ₹3-15 lakh upfront — aur abhi tak app sirf ban rahi hai. Launch hone ke baad ka marketing budget alag hai — Meta ads, Google ads, influencer marketing, content creation — yeh saari layers educator ke own time + cash se chalengi. Solo educator ke liye yeh sustainable nahi hai. Aur jab app finally chalti hai, tab tak market me 5 naye competitors aa chuke hote hain.

Question Often Asked

### Kya Flutter seekhke main khud apni coaching app bana sakta hu — bina developer hire kiye?

Theoretically yes — agar aapke pass 6-12 months full-time hain aur software engineering background hai. Practically no — aap educator hain, developer nahi. Flutter seekhna chhota nahi hai (40-60 hours just basics), aur production-grade coaching app ke liye state management, video streaming, push notifications, in-app payments, analytics — yeh sab ek-ek karke crack karne me 12+ months chahiye. Yeh 12 mahine teaching ke nahi hain. Educator ka opportunity cost — student ko teach karne ke 12 mahine + sambandhit ₹4-12 lakh missed revenue — iss route ka asli hidden cost hai jo kabhi calculate nahi hota.

DIY ke liye sirf ek scenario justified hai — aap large coaching institute hain (5,000+ students), aapke pass dedicated tech team hai, aur aapko absolute customization chahiye. Solo educator ya 50-500 student institutes ke liye yeh route economic suicide hai. White-label coaching app development cost India guide me iss math ka line-by-line breakdown hai.

"Mai khud app banwa lunga" wala thought 99% educators ka phase-1 dream hota hai. Aur 99% educators ka phase-1 grave bhi yahi hota hai.

Section 03

## Path 2 · White-label SaaS —
the ₹4–11 lakh trap.

White-label SaaS apps ka pitch DIY se zyada smart hota hai. "₹X,XXX/month me apni branded app — coding nahi, time nahi, sirf branding aur content". Aap signup karte hain, free trial chalti hai 14-30 din, phir paid plan start hota hai. Yahaan tak sab clear lagta hai. Real Year-1 cost ki layers signup ke time nahi dikhti — sirf invoice aane par dikhti hain.

White-label SaaS ka honest Year-1 cost decomposition kuch aisa dikhta hai (₹10 lakh annual revenue wale educator ke liye):

₹X
Advertised monthly plan

₹4–11L
Actual Year-1 outlay

7
Hidden cost layers

12 mo
Subscription lock-in

Advertised price × 12 = ~₹40K-1.5L. Real Year-1 = ₹4-11 lakh.

Yeh 7 hidden layers kya hain? Pehla — setup & migration fee (₹15-50K one-time). Doosra — custom domain + SSL (₹3-8K/year + ek-time setup). Teesra — payment gateway commission (Razorpay 2% standard, par white-label wallah aksar 1% additional layer charge karta hai). Chautha — video CDN + DRM (premium tier me extra ₹15-40K/year). Paanchwa — custom Play Store app build fee (₹50K-1.5L one-time). Chhata — marketing campaigns (Meta/Google ads jo platform run karta hai aapke behalf par — ₹1.5-5L/year). Saatva — annual subscription lock-in (cancel karne par penalty ya credit forfeit).

Across the AllCoaching educator base, hum dekhte hain ki educators jo white-label se migrate karke aate hain woh average ₹6.8 lakh Year-1 cost report karte hain — advertised number ka 8-12x. Yeh number sirf isliye nahi sun-ne ko milta kyunki sales team trial conversion par bonus paati hai, sticker shock par nahi. Best zero-commission teaching platform India me iss hidden cost analysis ka detailed financial decomposition diya gaya hai.

The honest pattern. White-label SaaS ki advertised price ₹X,XXX/month sirf landing page ka SEO hook hai. Year-1 real total ₹4-11 lakh ke beech aata hai. Yeh structural feature hai — aksar deliberate misdirection nahi, lekin economically educator ke against jaata hai.

Section 04

## Path 3 · Educator marketplace —
production-ready, ₹0.

Teesra raasta sabse naya hai aur sabse misunderstood. Educator marketplace woh model hai jaha har educator ka apna branded studio hota hai, aur saare studios ek shared discovery surface (AI-matched recommendations) par list hote hain. AllCoaching India ki first AI-driven educator marketplace hai. Architecture ki teen baatein important hain:

- Educator ka studio fully branded hota hai. Logo, colors, subdomain (rakesh-sir.allcoaching.in), tagline, course catalog — sab educator's own. Student-facing experience me AllCoaching ka small footer link sirf 'Powered by' line me dikhata hai.

- Marketplace discovery layer free tier me built-in hai. AI engine educator ka content (subject, exam, language, level, location) student search queries se match karta hai. Yeh wahi layer hai jo DIY ya white-label me alag se buy karna padti hai (₹1.5-5L/year of Meta/Google ads).

- Revenue-share model — educator paisa kamaya tabhi platform kamati hai. No upfront fee, no monthly subscription on base plan, no credit card at signup. 10% rev-share on paid student earnings. 90% educator ko, daily payouts via Razorpay rails.

Iska practical matlab kya hai? Educator ek single login me ek complete coaching business chalata hai — kursi pe baithke, mobile pe. Saare 7 infrastructure layers (next section me detailed) AllCoaching ke andar built-in. Educator ka focus 100% teaching par — content creation, live classes, student interaction. AllCoaching ka focus 100% infrastructure + discovery par. Yahi role separation educator ko zyada compounding deta hai DIY ya white-label se.

Strategic Definition

### Educator Marketplace

Multi-educator platform jaha har educator ka apna branded studio hota hai aur saare studios ek shared discovery surface (AI-matched recommendations) par list hote hain. AllCoaching India ki first AI-driven educator marketplace hai — combining the branding advantages of white-label apps with the discovery advantages of platform marketplaces. Zero upfront, revenue-share on paid earnings, no lock-in. (Full glossary entry: see below.)

Yeh model 2026 me dominate isliye kar raha hai kyunki Indian educator market mature ho gaya hai — 3.5 lakh+ isolated personal apps ban gaye hain (each fighting for the same student), aur students "app fatigue" face kar rahe hain. Ek shared marketplace jaha sab educators discoverable hain, student ke liye comparison-friendly hai, aur educator ke liye distribution-free hai. EdTech marketplace India app fatigue me iss thesis ka full architectural analysis hai.

## 7 infrastructure layers
jo har coaching app ko chahiye.

Coaching app banane ki cost samajhne ke liye, pehle yeh samajh lein ki ek production-grade coaching app me kya-kya layers hote hain. Bahut educators sirf "video upload" aur "payment lo" ke beech sochte hain — lekin reality me saat alag layers hain, har ek ka apna cost + complexity. Niche table me dono dikha rahe hain — alag-alag assemble karne ka annual cost, aur AllCoaching ke free tier me kya included hai:

₹15-50K
Live class server / year

₹20-60K
Video DRM & CDN / year

₹0-40K
Payment gateway setup

₹30-90K
Student CRM / year

₹40-1.2L
Fee management software

₹1.5-5L
Marketing & discovery / year

₹15-40K
GST + invoicing / year

Total Year-1 standalone assembly: ₹2.7L–11L. AllCoaching free tier: ₹0.

Yeh saat layers ko ek-ek karke unpack karte hain:

- Live class server. Zoom-like infrastructure jaha attendance tracking, recording, doubt-solving, breakout rooms ho. DIY route me Zoom subscription (₹1.2K/month) + custom integration; white-label me usually built-in but premium tier feature. AllCoaching free tier me unlimited live classes + automatic recording included.

- Video DRM & CDN. HLS+AES encrypted streaming, forensic watermarking, screen-record blocking. Without DRM aapki recorded lectures Telegram pe leak ho jaayengi 30 din me. Premium video CDN + DRM ₹20-60K/year standalone. AllCoaching me included.

- Payment gateway. UPI/card/net-banking/EMI accept karne ka infrastructure. Razorpay standalone account free me available hai but onboarding 5-7 din, KYC complete karna pad ta hai, GST registration zaruri hai. AllCoaching me pre-integrated — student pay karta hai, agle business day educator ke bank account me 90% land hota hai.

- Student CRM. Attendance, fee payment status, course progress, communication history. 20+ students par WhatsApp + Excel khatm ho jaate hain — Excel formulas tut-te hain, WhatsApp groups overflowing ho jaate hain. Standalone CRM ₹30-90K/year. AllCoaching free tier me built-in.

- Fee management. Installment tracking, automatic reminders, GST-compliant invoicing, refund processing. Automated fee management software for teachers guide me detail hai. Manual tracking 100+ students par cripple hota hai — 8-12 hours/week wasted on fee chase. AllCoaching me auto-reminders + invoicing included.

- Marketing & discovery. Yahi sabse expensive layer hai — aur most underestimated. DIY/white-label me aapko Meta + Google ads chalane padte hain, content marketing, SEO, influencer tie-ups — annual ₹1.5-5L typical. AllCoaching me yeh layer hi nahi hai — kyunki marketplace AI students ko aapke profile tak organically pahunchata hai. Yeh structural advantage hai, monetary nahi sirf.

- GST + invoicing. India me coaching services par 18% GST applicable hai (specific exemptions ke alawa). Manual invoicing chartered accountant ko outsource ya in-house karna ₹15-40K/year. AllCoaching me automatic GST-compliant invoices per transaction generate hote hain.

Total Year-1 standalone assembly cost: ₹2.7 lakh se ₹11 lakh. AllCoaching free tier me yeh saat layers built-in milti hain — ₹0 upfront, 10% rev-share on paid earnings only. Yeh sirf cost saving nahi hai — yeh time saving hai. DIY route me yeh saari layers wire karne me 3-6 months chahiye. AllCoaching me 60 seconds.

Section 06

## AllCoaching ka 60-second onboarding —
6 steps se branded studio live.

Theory bahut ho gayi. Ab dekhte hain practically AllCoaching par signup kaise hota hai. Educator setup wizard 6 simple steps me complete hota hai. Most educators iss flow ko 60 seconds me complete kar lete hain — pehla paid student aane me uske baad 24-48 hours lagte hain (kyunki ek course upload + ek live class schedule kar na hota hai).

Yahaan har step ka breakdown hai — exactly jaisa studio.allcoaching.in par dikhta hai:

01

Step Verify
Time ~10 seconds
Input Mobile · OTP

### Mobile number verify karein.

Outcome — Educator identity confirmed
Indian mobile number enter karein. 256-bit encrypted channel par 6-digit OTP aata hai instant. No email, no password — mobile aapki single source of identity hai.

Iska reason hai: India me educators WhatsApp + UPI ke mental model me operate karte hain. Mobile OTP woh familiar pattern hai. Email-password authentication 30% educators ke liye friction tha — iss flow se woh friction zero hai.

02

Step You
Time ~10 seconds
Input Name · WhatsApp

### Apna naam aur WhatsApp add karein.

Outcome — Public-facing educator identity
Apna pura naam likhein jaisa aap students ko dikhana chahein. Plus WhatsApp number jo aap student support ke liye use karenge. Yeh dono educator's public-facing identity ka core ban-te hain.

WhatsApp number zaruri kyun? Kyunki Indian students 87% pe educator se direct contact WhatsApp pe karte hain. AllCoaching iss connection ko built-in deti hai — student studio se ek click pe educator ke WhatsApp pe land karta hai.

03

Step Subject
Time ~10 seconds
Input What you teach

### Apna teaching subject choose karein.

Outcome — AI marketplace matching enabled
Subject, exam, ya skill select karein (NEET Physics, CA Foundation, UPSC GS, IIT Maths, Class XII Chemistry, etc.). Yahi field AI-marketplace ke matching engine ko drive karti hai — aapke saath relevant students kaise match honge.

Niche depth matters here. "Sab padha leta hu" wale educator ki marketplace visibility limited rehti hai. "JEE Mains Physics — Mechanics + Modern Physics" type ka specific niche aapko exam-aligned search queries me bahut prominently surface karta hai.

04

Step Brand
Time ~10 seconds
Input Logo · Colors

### Apne studio ko brand karein.

Outcome — White-labeled student experience
Apna logo upload karein aur brand colors choose karein. AllCoaching aapke educator studio ko fully white-label kar deta hai — student-facing experience me aapka brand prominent dikhta hai, AllCoaching ka logo sirf footer ke 'Powered by' line me chhota dikhata hai.

Logo nahi hai abhi? Skip kar sakte hain, default placeholder set ho jaata hai. Baad me kabhi bhi educator studio settings se update kar sakte hain. Brand customization is reversible — design choices educator ki own raheti hain.

05

Step Plan
Time ~10 seconds
Input Free base / Paid

### Plan choose karein — free base ya paid.

Outcome — Studio access tier locked
Free base plan select karein — core teaching features free, no credit card. Ya agar aapko advance se pata hai ki advanced features chahiye, optional paid tier select karein. Free base plan hamesha permanently free rehta hai — koi trial expiry nahi; sirf advanced features (custom domain, advanced analytics) optional paid tier me hain.

Signup par credit card nahi maanga jaata, aur koi trial-jo-khatm-ho nahi hai. Automatic charge kabhi nahi hota — aap manually decide karte hain optional paid tier pe shift karna hai ya free base plan par chalte rehna hai.

06

Step Launch
Time Instant
Outcome Studio live

### Launch — aapka studio live hai.

Outcome — Public URL active, ready for students
Aapka branded studio ab live hai — ek public URL ke saath jo aap students ko share kar sakte hain. Pehla course upload karein, ek live class schedule karein, URL share karein. Most educators 48 hours ke andar apna first paid batch run kar lete hain.

500+ educators har mahine iss flow se join karte hain (educator signup page ka own social proof). Iss number ka matter yeh hai ki onboarding scale par tested hai — edge cases, slow connections, regional language input, sab handle hota hai.

Honest concession
60 seconds setup ka matlab "60 seconds me first paid student" nahi hai. Setup me 60 second — first paid student me 24-48 hours, kyunki uske beech aapko ek course upload + ek live class schedule karna hota hai. Yeh time content creation ka hai, infrastructure ka nahi. Technology bottleneck nahi rehti.

Strategic Conclusion

## Apna coaching app banane ka
asli answer.

Wapas chal-te hain shuru ke sawal par — "apna coaching app kaise banaye free?" Iss guide ke baad answer specific hai aur teen-layer ka hai:

Pehla layer — "free" ka real definition. Free matlab ₹0 upfront cash outlay + ₹0 monthly subscription. Iss definition par sirf educator marketplace route fit karta hai — DIY (₹3-15L upfront) aur white-label (₹40K-1.5L advertised + ₹4-11L hidden) dono fail karte hain.

Doosra layer — raasta choose karne ka criterion. Aap solo educator hain ya 50-500 student institute? Marketplace route default hai. 5,000+ students wale large institutes aur jin ke pass dedicated tech team hai sirf woh DIY consider karein. White-label SaaS sirf woh educators choose karein jin ke pass clear reason hai paid features upfront chahiye (rare scenario).

Teesra layer — execution sequence. AllCoaching par 60-second onboarding karein → pehla course 24 hours me upload → pehla live class 48 hours me schedule → pehla paid batch 7 din ke andar launch → 30 din pe metrics review → 6 mahine pe optional paid-tier decision. Yeh sequence har step par revocable hai — kahi bhi stop kar sakte hain, kahi bhi pivot kar sakte hain.

2026 me jo educators thrive kar rahe hain, unka ek consistent pattern hai. Unhone:

- DIY ka "khud app banwa lunga" wala dream chhoda aur marketplace pe shuru kiya.

- White-label ki advertised price ko ignore kiya aur Year-1 real total dekha — phir step back kiya.

- Marketing/discovery ko app banane ka by-product samjha — woh actual primary problem hai jo architecture me solve hoti hai, baad me bolt-on nahi.

- Free me launch kiya, validate kiya, phir paid tier ka decision liya — speculation nahi.

Aapka coaching business kal nahi banega — aaj ban sakta hai. Mobile lijiye, studio.allcoaching.in pe jaayein, 60 seconds me studio live ho jaayega. Pehla paid student 48 hours me aa sakta hai. Yeh hyperbole nahi, observable reality hai jo 500+ educators har mahine demonstrate kar rahe hain.

"Free coaching app banane ka sabse honest answer yeh hai — sahi architecture choose kijiye, free ek by-product banega. AllCoaching ne ye choice educator ke liye default bana di hai."

— Amit Ratan, Founder & CEO, AllCoaching

Glossary

## Key terms —
iss guide ke.

Term

### Coaching App

Mobile + web platform jaha educator apne students ko courses, live classes, tests, aur study material deliver karta hai. Modern coaching apps me payment gateway, student CRM, video DRM, aur discovery layer integrated hote hain — sirf "video upload" platform nahi.

Term

### White-Label SaaS (Coaching)

SaaS platform jaha educator apne logo + brand name pe ek pre-built coaching app ka access leta hai. Advertised price ₹X,XXX/month hoti hai, lekin Year-1 hidden costs (migration, domain, gateway, DRM, marketing) ₹4–11 lakh tak ja sakti hain. Classplus, Teachmint type platforms iss category me aate hain.

Term

### Revenue Share Model

Educator paisa kamaata hai tabhi platform commission leta hai (typically 10–20%). No upfront fee, no monthly subscription. AllCoaching me 10% rev-share on paid earnings only — educator 90% rakhta hai. Yeh model educator aur platform ke incentives align karta hai.

Term

### Video DRM (Anti-Piracy)

Digital Rights Management — encrypted video streaming (HLS+AES) + forensic watermarking + device-binding + screen-record blocking. Coaching apps me critical layer hai kyunki recorded lectures asset hain jo easily pirated ho jaate hain agar plain MP4 hosting kiya jaaye. Standalone DRM ₹20-60K/year; AllCoaching me included.

Term

### Payment Gateway (Coaching)

Software layer jo student se UPI/card/net-banking/EMI me payment accept karta hai aur educator ke bank account me transfer karta hai. India me Razorpay aur Cashfree dominant hain. Standalone integration me 1–3% transaction fee + setup chahiye; AllCoaching me built-in, daily payouts.

Term

### Student CRM (Coaching)

Tooling for tracking student attendance, fee payment status, course progress, communication history, aur engagement signals. 20+ active students par WhatsApp + Excel breakdown ho jaata hai — Excel formulas tut-te hain, WhatsApp groups overflow karte hain. AllCoaching free tier me built-in CRM milta hai.

Term

### Educator Marketplace

Multi-educator platform jaha har educator ka apna branded studio hota hai aur saare studios ek shared discovery surface (AI-matched recommendations) par list hote hain. AllCoaching India ki first AI-driven educator marketplace hai — combining the branding advantages of white-label apps with the discovery advantages of platform marketplaces.

Term

### Marketplace Listing (AllCoaching)

Educator ka discoverable profile inside AllCoaching ki AI-driven multi-educator marketplace. AI recommendation engine educator ka content student search query (exam, subject, language, level, location) se match karke organic enrolment generate karta hai — paid Meta/Google ads ka structural alternative.

FAQ

## Aksar puche jaane wale
sawaal.

Apna coaching app free me kaise banaye 2026 me?
2026 me apna coaching app free me banane ka sabse practical raasta hai — AllCoaching jaisi AI-driven educator marketplace par 60-second onboarding complete karna. ₹0 upfront, no credit card, no coding. Aapko milta hai branded studio, live class server, video DRM, payment gateway, student CRM, aur marketplace discovery — sab integrated. DIY (Flutter/developer hire) me 6 mahine + ₹3-15 lakh lagte hain; white-label SaaS me Year-1 cost ₹4-11 lakh hota hai. Marketplace route me sirf 10% revenue-share paid earnings par.

Kya AllCoaching par really ₹0 upfront me coaching app milta hai?
Haan. AllCoaching ka educator base plan permanently free hai — no upfront fee, no monthly subscription on the free tier, no credit card required at signup. Base plan me core teaching features free unlocked rehte hain, aur base plan hamesha free rehta hai — koi trial expiry nahi. Sirf advanced features (advanced analytics, white-label custom domain, priority support) optional paid tier me hain. Revenue model rev-share par chalta hai — 10% on paid earnings, 90% educator ko.

Free coaching app aur paid coaching app me kya farak hai?
Free tier me aapko complete teaching infrastructure milti hai — courses, live classes, payments, student CRM, marketplace discovery. Paid tier (₹999-4999/month) advanced analytics, custom domain branding, priority WhatsApp support, aur extended marketing tools deti hai. Most solo educators pehle 6-12 mahine free tier par hi profitable ho jaate hain — paid features tab matter karte hain jab aap 100+ students ya multi-batch scale par pahuchte hain.

DIY (Flutter, hire developer) ke saath coaching app banane me kitna time lagega?
DIY route me realistic timeline 4-9 mahine hai, aur upfront cost ₹3-15 lakh hota hai. Aap ek developer team hire karenge (₹50K-₹2L/month × 4-6 months), UI/UX designer (₹40K-₹1L), backend infrastructure setup (AWS/GCP, ₹15-50K/month recurring), payment gateway integration (Razorpay/Cashfree onboarding), Apple/Google Play Store submission (₹10K total), aur post-launch maintenance budget rakhna padega. Iske baad bhi marketing aur student discovery alag layer hai jiska kharcha alag. Most solo educators DIY route adhuri chhod dete hain Phase 2 me hi.

White-label coaching app (Classplus/Teachmint type) ka real cost kya hota hai?
White-label SaaS apps ki advertised price ₹X,XXX/month hoti hai — lekin Year-1 ka real total ₹4-11 lakh ke beech aata hai. Iss me migration setup fee, custom domain + SSL, payment gateway commission (1-3%), video CDN + DRM, custom app build fee, Play Store listing, marketing campaigns, aur 12-month subscription lock-in shamil hota hai. Aksar educator ko yeh hidden costs sirf invoice ke time pata chalte hain.

AllCoaching ka 60-second onboarding kya genuinely 60 second me complete hota hai?
Setup steps 60 second me complete hote hain — mobile OTP, name + WhatsApp, subject, brand color/logo, plan select, launch. Studio live hone me 60 second. Lekin pehla paid student aane me 24-48 hours average lagte hain — kyunki uske beech aapko ek course upload karna hota hai aur ek live class schedule karna hota hai. Setup ki technical complexity zero hai — actual teaching content kitna ready hai woh single bottleneck hai.

Apne coaching app ke liye custom domain (jaise rakeshsir.in) chahiye to free me milega?
Free tier par aapko AllCoaching sub-path URL milta hai jaise allcoaching.in/rakesh-sir — production-ready aur shareable. Custom domain (rakeshsir.in) paid tier feature hai — woh ₹999-1499/month plan me available hota hai aur SSL certificate include hota hai. Most solo educators pehle 6-12 mahine free sub-path par hi launch karte hain — custom domain tab matter karta hai jab brand recall important ho jaata hai.

Kya AllCoaching ka coaching app Play Store aur App Store par list hota hai?
AllCoaching ki single Student App Play Store par live hai (org.student.allcoaching) — saare educators ke courses iss app ke andar accessible hain. Individual educator ke liye alag Play Store listing free tier me available nahi hai — woh paid white-label tier feature hai. Lekin free tier par aapko apna branded studio URL milta hai (web + mobile responsive), aur AllCoaching ke shared student app par aapka full storefront list hota hai.

Free coaching app par main apni branding (logo, colors, name) kar sakta hu?
Haan — free tier par bhi educator studio fully white-labeled hai. Aap apna logo upload kar sakte hain, brand colors set kar sakte hain, apna naam aur tagline rakh sakte hain. Student-facing experience me aapka brand prominent dikhta hai. AllCoaching ka logo sirf footer ke 'Powered by AllCoaching' line me chhota dikhata hai (free tier). Custom domain aur footer-removal paid tier features hain.

Kya AllCoaching pe daily payouts hote hain ya monthly?
AllCoaching pe payouts daily hote hain — student ne payment ki, agle business day educator ke registered bank account me 90% credit ho jaata hai (10% AllCoaching ka revenue share). Razorpay-powered settlement infrastructure use hota hai. GST-compliant invoices automatic generate hote hain. Daily payouts ka matter yeh hai ki cash-flow educator ke saath rehta hai — competitor platforms aksar 7-30 day hold rakhte hain jo small institutes ke liye crippling ho sakta hai.

Section 01

## "Free coaching app kaise banayein?" —
yeh galat sawaal hai.

Har mahine AllCoaching ko saikdon Indian teachers se ek hi sawaal aata hai — "Sir, mujhe free me apna coaching app banana hai. Kaise shuru karoon?" Sawaal innocent lagta hai, but yeh fundamentally misdirected hai. App banana 2026 me commodity hai — har white-label SaaS company ₹X,XXX/month me branded app provision kar degi, kai "free trial" ka offer bhi denge. Asli sawaal woh nahi hai. Asli sawaal yeh hai — app ban gaya, phir students kaha se aayenge? Yahi woh moment hai jab baat coaching app se shift ho kar coaching marketplace par aati hai. Yahi iss guide ka central thesis hai.

Pichle 5 saal me, especially pandemic (2020-22) ke baad, India me ek false promise bahut loudly sell hua — "apna branded coaching app lao, apne students khud collect karo, beech me koi platform nahi chahiye." 2026 tak, manifesto me jo data document hai uske anusaar 3.5 lakh Indian teachers ne apne personal coaching apps launch kiye. Unme se majority — anuman 88% — aaj bhi sustainable revenue nahi kamate. App hai, content hai, ambition hai. Students nahi hain. Yeh failure pedagogy ki nahi hai, yeh failure architecture ki hai.

Sahi pehla sawaal

### "Mujhe app chahiye ya audience?"

Agar answer "audience" hai, to coaching marketplace structurally correct choice hai. AllCoaching India ka pehla AI-driven educator marketplace hai jaha teachers free me join kar sakte hain, aur jaha distribution (student discovery) hosting layer me built-in hai. Agar answer "app, audience main khud le aaunga" hai, to white-label SaaS ek option hai — but realistic Year-1 cost ₹4–11 lakh hai aur most solo educators iss math ko correctly model nahi kar paate. Yeh guide usi structural distinction ko unpack karta hai.

Ek practical example: ek NEET Biology teacher Lucknow me, 8 saal ka teaching experience, achha content, batch me 80 students. 2023 me unhone Classplus se branded coaching app liya. 2024 tak app me ₹6 lakh invest ho chuke the (subscription + domain + DRM + marketing) — aur app me sirf 40 paying students aaye, unme se 30 already existing physical batch ke students the. Naye students 10 aaye — 2.5 lakh per student acquisition cost. Yeh failure model nahi hai, yeh THE model hai — white-label apps ke liye. Marketplace me same teacher 90 days me bina ₹0 marketing ke 220 naye paid students tak pahunch gaye, because Hindi-medium NEET Biology category me AI-matching ne unka content surface kar diya. Distribution architecture ka seedha fark.

Sabse mehnga coaching software woh nahi hai jiska sticker price zyada hai. Sabse mehnga coaching software woh hai jo distribution problem solve nahi karta — kyunki bina students ke, har dashboard expensive hai.

· · ·

Section 02 · Reality Check

## 3.5 lakh apps, 0 students —
India ka sabse silent EdTech failure.

2020 se 2024 ke beech India me 3.5 lakh educators ne apna branded coaching app launch kiya. Yeh AllCoaching ka manufactured stat nahi hai — yeh Classplus, Teachmint, Graphy aur cumulatively chhote white-label vendors ke public-disclosed aankde hain. App-builder platforms ne isko "democratization of education" ke roop me sell kiya. Reality yeh hai ki un 3.5 lakh apps me se approximately 12% sustainable revenue kamate hain — yaani 88% educator kuch paisa zaroor kamate hain, but app maintenance + marketing + opportunity cost cover nahi ho paata. Math negative hai.

Yeh kyun hua? Kyunki app banana ≠ audience banana. White-label SaaS companies app bechti hain — aapko app + dashboard milta hai. "Students kaise aayenge" yeh aapki problem hai. Aur solo educator ke paas us problem ko solve karne ka budget ya infrastructure nahi hai. Meta + Google ads par ek small educator ₹10,000/month spend karta hai, unke muqable me Byju's, Unacademy ₹100 crore/year spend karte hain. Yeh fair fight nahi hai — yeh kabhi fair fight tha hi nahi. Personal app architecturally us fight ko expect karta hai.

India me Personal Coaching App ka Honest 2026 Math (500 students target)

- White-label SaaS subscription (Classplus/Teachmint tier-2): ₹30K–₹2L/year

- Setup + migration + custom branding: ₹25K–₹2L one-time

- Custom domain + SSL + email infrastructure: ₹15K–₹40K/year

- Payment gateway transaction commission (1.5–3% on ₹15L revenue): ₹22K–₹45K/year

- Video CDN + DRM add-on (Widevine L1 if courses include premium video): ₹40K–₹2L/year

- Push notification + SMS pack: ₹24K–₹90K/year

- Marketing (Meta/Google ads + reels production + content marketing): ₹2L–₹6L/year

- Lock-in penalty (12-month subscription, migration cost agar chhodna ho): opportunity cost

- Year-1 real total: ₹4–11 lakh — 500 students target, adhiktar educator ke liye payback period 18–30 months

Yeh woh number hai jo white-label sales pitch me kabhi upfront nahi aata. Headline pricing — "Bas ₹4,999/month me apna app launch karo!" — us ₹4-11 lakh reality ka teesra ya chautha hissa hai. 2026 me hum white-label coaching app development cost India guide me iss math ka line-by-line breakdown publish kar chuke hain. Read kar lein, phir wapis aaiye. Yahaan par argument continue karte hain.

To agar 3.5 lakh educators ka app hai, aur 88% sustainable revenue nahi kamate, aur real cost ₹4-11 lakh per year hai — to structural problem kya hai? Distribution. Discovery. Network effect. Har personal app ek walled garden hai — aap un students ke saamne visible hain jo aapko already jante hain. Baaki India ke liye aap invisible hain. Yahi coaching marketplace structurally solve karta hai.

· · ·

Section 03 · The Structural Distinction

## Coaching App vs Coaching Marketplace —
do completely different categories.

Yeh distinction itna important hai ki agar isko aap internalize kar lein, to baaki sab decisions easy ho jaate hain. Coaching app ek tool hai. Coaching marketplace ek ecosystem hai. Dono me architectural differences hain jo har metric ko affect karte hain — cost, time-to-first-student, scalability, aur sabse important: long-term viability.

Coaching app — Classplus, Teachmint, Graphy, ya custom Flutter build — single-educator branded experience hai. Aapka app, aapka logo, aapke students. "Aapke students" bashar te aap unko la sakein. App-builder aapko infrastructure deta hai: payment gateway, video hosting, course catalogue, attendance, push notifications. Uske baad app empty hai. Students apne aap nahi aate. Aap Instagram reels banayenge, paid ads chalayenge, WhatsApp groups me share karenge, existing batch ko convert karenge — aur jab woh sab karoge, tabhi students aayenge (some).

Coaching marketplace — AllCoaching iss category ka first real India launch hai — fundamentally alag architecture hai. Yahaan har educator ka apna branded studio hai, but saare studios ek shared discovery surface par list hote hain. Students Hindi-medium NEET Biology search karte hain, AI matching engine unko best-fit educators recommend karti hai, conversion happens cross-educator. Yeh marketplace dynamics hai — restaurant + Zomato jaisa, seller + Amazon jaisa, driver + Uber jaisa, coaching educator + AllCoaching jaisa.

Structural Comparison

### Ek NEET Biology teacher ka experience

Personal app me: Day 1 — app live. Students: 0. Day 30 — Meta ads ₹50K spent. Students: 18 enrolled, 4 paid. Cost per student: ₹12,500. Day 90 — Total spend ₹2 lakh. Students: 60 enrolled, 22 paid. Payback period: 14 months.

Marketplace me: Day 1 — studio live + marketplace listing active. Students: 0 marketing se, but AI discovery engine ne NEET Biology Hindi-medium queries par surface karna shuru kar diya. Day 7 — pehle 12 students organic discovery se. Day 30 — 80 students enrolled, 38 paid. Day 90 — 220 paid students. ₹0 marketing spend. Payback: instant.

Yeh bahut bada structural difference hai. Coaching app me distribution aapki responsibility hai — coaching marketplace me distribution platform ki core feature hai. Yeh koi marketing claim nahi hai, yeh architectural difference hai. Marketplace ko banane ka engineering cost bahut zyada hai (cross-educator search, recommendation engine, multi-language AI matching, cross-discovery analytics) — yahi reason hai kyun yeh category India me 2026 tak exist nahi karti thi. AllCoaching ne iss layer ko pehli baar build kiya hai.

"App hai, students nahi hain" — yeh India ke 3 lakh se zyada educators ki vaastvikta hai 2026 me. Yeh content failure nahi hai. Yeh architecture failure hai. App tool hai, marketplace ecosystem hai — dono ko confuse mat kariye.

· · ·

Section 04 · The Six Pains

## The Educator's Trap —
Reach vs Revenue vs Reality.

Jab personal app distribution-less hota hai, to educator ke paas limited options bachte hain. Manifesto me humne ise "the educator's trap" kaha hai — 6 pains jo har solo personal-app educator face karta hai. Yahaan unka condensed version hai, kyunki yahi pains coaching marketplace structurally solve karta hai.

- Pain 01 — Teaching ki jagah Entertaining. Organic reach social media par drama, humour, outrage reward karta hai. Ek chemistry teacher jo reaction mechanisms par master hai, ab 60-second reels script karne me hours spend karta hai. Algorithm ne medium reshape kiya, medium ne teaching quality reshape ki. Marketplace me discovery quality-driven hai (reviews, completion rates, exam outcomes), entertainment-driven nahi.

- Pain 02 — Marketing budget eating Curriculum budget. Har rupaya Meta ads par kharch hone wala ek rupaya better curriculum, study material, co-teacher hire par kharch nahi ho raha. Solo educator ka ₹10K/month marketing budget vs Byju's ka ₹100 crore/year — competition ek same metric par hai, matlab unfair. Marketplace me organic discovery ka layer hai, paid acquisition optional.

- Pain 03 — Technical dard. Payment gateway integration fail at checkout. Push notification system configuration. Video DRM (Widevine L1) maintenance. OTP costs. CDN bills. Har teacher accidentally part-time software product manager ban jata hai. Marketplace me yeh sab platform handle karti hai — ek hi shared infrastructure.

- Pain 04 — Hidden costs at every step. App listing fees, transaction cuts, annual maintenance, SMS OTP, server scaling, content CDN. Sticker price ₹X,XXX/month, real Year-1 ₹4-11 lakh. Marketplace me revenue-share model — pay only when you earn.

- Pain 05 — Digital isolation. Personal app ek walled garden hai — koi cross-educator network effect nahi, koi shared trust signal nahi. Aap un students ko visible hain jo already aapko jante hain. Marketplace me har new educator dusre educators ke students ke liye discoverable hai.

- Pain 06 — Teach karne ki freedom chali jaati hai. Sabse severe consequence — India ke best educators apna sabse productive time us kaam par spend kar rahe hain jo woh best nahi hain. Marketplace ka central promise yahi hai: teach karo, baaki sab hum handle karte hain.

From the Field

### Across the AllCoaching educator base, 2026

Humne 5,000+ educators ke onboarding journey ka pattern observe kiya hai. Personal app se marketplace me switch karne wale educators me 78% ka primary motivation distribution tha (cost nahi) — "app ke paas dashboard hai but students nahi" tha most common complaint. Yeh 2024 ke muqable 31% badha hai — distribution-awareness market me kaafi mature ho rahi hai.

· · ·

Section 05 · The Other Side

## Student ka Nightmare —
3.5 lakh apps, 0 discovery.

Ab ulta side dekhiye. Ek student Patna me SSC CGL prepare kar raha hai. Usko achha reasoning teacher chahiye. Ek friend ne ek teacher recommend kiya. Teacher ka personal app hai. Student ne download kiya, register kiya, OTP daala, profile complete kiya, course browse kiya. Phir maths teacher ka alag app, English grammar teacher ka alag app, mock test ke liye alag app. 4 apps ho gaye. Har app me alag registration, alag OTP, alag payment info. Friction compounding hai.

Student ki cognitive load exponentially badhti hai har new app ke saath. Download barrier, registration barrier, trust barrier, payment barrier — 4 baar. Aur har step par drop-off hoti hai. Ek course personal app me jisko 200 logon ne download kiya, usko 40 logon ne dekha, 8 logon ne purchase kiya. Educator ise content failure samajhta hai. Yeh content failure nahi hai, yeh infrastructure failure hai. Yaani, even best content sahi discovery mechanism ke bina suffer karta hai.

"Student ke liye har personal app ek locked room hai jisme ghusne ke liye use beg karna padta hai. India ka best teacher invisible hai agar woh ek download wall ke peeche hai jise climb karne ka tareeqa koi nahi jaanta."

Coaching marketplace yeh problem fundamentally solve karta hai. Student ek baar AllCoaching app download karta hai — Play Store par single app. Ek login, ek profile, ek trusted platform. Phir 22 languages me discovery, 100+ exam categories, lakhs of educators searchable. Same student jo 4 alag apps ka struggle kar raha tha, marketplace me ek app ke andar sab discover kar sakta hai. Friction zero. Conversion rate naturally jaati hai.

Yeh deep injustice hai fragmented personal-app ecosystem ki — yeh sirf educators ko hurt nahi karta, yeh students ko best teachers se actively deprive karta hai. Discovery merit-based nahi rehti, marketing-budget-based ho jaati hai. Yaani jiska zyada ad budget hai woh discover hota hai, jo zyada achha padhata hai woh nahi. Marketplace yeh invert karta hai — quality (reviews, ratings, completion, exam outcomes) discovery drive karti hai.

· · ·

Section 06 · The Other Option

## Big EdTech kyun aapki friend nahi hai —
Absorption, not Partnership.

Teesra option — "Personal app ki headache chhodo, bade platform join kar lo, reach to built-in hai." Unacademy Educator, Vedantu Educator, Byju's tutor side — yeh sab option aate hain. Surface par sahi lagta hai: massive reach, proven infrastructure, brand trust. But jo woh structurally offer karte hain, woh partnership nahi hai — woh absorption hai.

Big EdTech par join karne ke baad kya hota hai? Aapki brand identity gayab ho jaati hai. Students aapke paas enroll nahi karte — woh platform par enroll karte hain. Aapka naam listed hai, but relationship platform ka hai. Aap chale gaye to students nahi aate aapke saath. Reviews nahi aati. Data nahi aata. Content rights aksar shared. Aap leave karte hain to literally kuch nahi le ja sakte. Yeh portability ki death hai.

Aapki aay kabhi puri aapki nahi hoti. Revenue split typically 40–60% educator ko, baaki platform. Yeh isliye possible hai kyunki platform discovery control karti hai. Aur jab tak woh discovery control karti hai, woh revenue bhi control karegi. Yeh pricing nahi hai — yeh structural reality hai. Naya educator aata hai to aapka content deprioritize ho sakta hai. Aap apne hi platform ke incentives se fight kar rahe hain.
